create_config_unispeech_sat: create a UniSpeechSatConfig instance with default architecture parameters for the microsoft/unispeech-sat-base-100h-libri-ft model
configure_feature_encoder: configure the UniSpeechSatConfig feature encoder with custom conv_dim, conv_stride, and conv_kernel tuples
validate_architecture_config: validate the UniSpeechSatConfig architecture by calling validate_architecture to check conv_dim, conv_stride, and conv_kernel length consistency
compute_inputs_to_logits_ratio: compute the inputs_to_logits_ratio property from UniSpeechSatConfig by reducing conv_stride with multiplication
configure_spec_augment_masking: configure UniSpeechSatConfig with SpecAugment parameters including mask_time_prob, mask_time_length, mask_feature_prob, and mask_feature_length
